text:
mike: Kicking off the v2 rollout plan in tonight's quiet window (23:00-02:00 UTC). Using clockwork ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% in 20m steps. Flag key: feature.v2_rollout. Deploybot will perform the weight shifts.
sarah: +1. Can we pin traffic for internal beta to v2 until the 2nd step? want us to catch the smoke tests earlier.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled run: 2025-07-15T23:00:00Z. Will apply ramps at 20m intervals. Will pause on any holdpoint triggers.

mike: yes pin internal-beta cohort id: beta-internal -> 100% to v2, will be excluded from ramp backoff. Add to the runbook: command to unpin if needed.
nora: putting rollback criteria here: 1) error rate > 0.8% sustained for 5m, 2) P95 latency increase > 250ms vs baseline for 3 consecutive windows, 3) repeatable regeneration mismatch on canonical prompt set. If any hit, immediate flag disable and notify pager.
liam: confirm ops playbook for quick disable: 
```
# Disable flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_API" \ 
  https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/feature.v2_rollout/disable
# verify
curl https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/feature.v2_rollout | jq .status
```
liam: deploybot has permission to execute the disable command if oncall approves.
oncall-ryan: I'll be oncall during the window. If deploy-bot pauses for a holdpoint I'll check metrics within 3m and either ack to continue or instruct rollback. Ping me @ryan.

mike: small note on version pinning for shared services: when we shift 20% -> 100% we should pin model-route v2.1 -> so sessions don't mix models mid-session. Add to run: /ops/pin-model model-route=v2.1
sarah: release notes blurb for product: "gradual rollout of v2 improves completion latency and reduces hallucination for agent prompts; will be enabled for all users after validation." Keep short.

deploy-bot: status update: preflight smoke passed in staging at 22:10 UTC. ready for schedule. Will create a checkpoint message at each ramp step and annotate with telemetry snapshot.
mike: :thumbsup: We'll monitor tail errors and semantic eval set. If everything stays green at 20% for 40m we can consider accelerating the last step. Otherwise stick to clockwork exact intervals.
sarah: one more ask — add a temporary 5% traffic drain reserve in eu-west in case of capacity spikes (config: reserve=5%). That way we can shift without hitting pod autoscaler limits.
liam: noted. I'll apply reserve via deployment config and update the deploybot run.
oncall-ryan: ack. I'll stand by. If I don't respond within 5m of a holdpoint, deploy-bot will automatically disable the flag per policy. Documented in runbook.
mike: Thanks team — proceeding on schedule. Will post final ramp summary in this thread after cutoff.
